lessons: For AtomCode-mediated experimental providers, max_tokens and wrapper invocation timeout are distinct qualification dimensions; a near-complete long action can be transport-limited even when model-content capacity is adequate.

A timeout repair should be prospective and single-variable: preserve model, prompt, parser, fixtures and token budget, then requalify the identical non-scientific packet before opening scientific source authority.

AtomGit Qwen3.8 provider-managed decoding exhibits substantial within-condition first-action diversity on repeated identical fixtures; PACTA-style within-branch noise calibration is therefore operationally relevant rather than vacuous on this provider.
